featured.quote: Watching the focus, coordination, energy and joy of the young dancers was a wonderful, memorable experience. EnLiven dancers have touched my heart and deepened my appreciation of the rich traditions conveyed in dance forms from India.
featured.name: Barbara Pyles
featured.photoAlt: A dancer in costume speaking with a resident at North Hill

cards.label: Surgeon General
cards.quote: What a remarkable initiative you've built! I love that you are focusing on intergenerational connections… For all the shiny objects and milestones that society has us chase, what really makes a difference in whether or not we find fulfillment are moments we spend loving people and serving others.

cards.label: North Hill
cards.quote: We're still talking about your marvelous performance at North Hill. Particularly touching was the inclusion — the age range and talent from beginner to expert. Your love of dance was contagious, as you could tell from the endless applause. We need to schedule an encore visit.

cards.label: Waterstone at Wellesley
cards.quote: The program presented was very enjoyable, but I must say the conversation back and forth was magnificent. The students then mingled with the audience, and did not leave in a hurry but stayed for a while. I was so impressed and lifted, as were others.
